Prestige House, Catford SE6

From the first appraisal to the finished building

We develop on our own account and with partners. We appraise the site, take it through planning and build it with our own construction team, so the people who priced the scheme are the people who deliver it.

Recent schemes are new-build apartments and licensed HMOs. Each completed scheme was signed off by building control.

Our own schemes

Prestige House, Catford SE6

Nine new apartments, completed May 2022

Nine apartments on the site of a former gas reduction facility. Part of the original building was demolished and part converted, and a new three-storey block on piled foundations was added around a shared garden.

  • Five one-bedroom and four two-bedroom apartments
  • Building control sign-off in May 2022
  • 10-year structural warranty

Nine-bedroom HMO, Hampstead NW3

Conversion of a Victorian house, completed August 2024

A Victorian house on Finchley Road converted into nine private suites, each with its own en-suite bathroom and kitchenette, with shared kitchens on the ground and top floors.

  • Nine en-suite rooms with kitchenettes
  • Two shared kitchens
  • Building control final certificate, August 2024

Six-bedroom HMO, Acton W3

Conversion and refurbishment, March to October 2026

A house converted and fully refurbished into a licensed six-bedroom HMO, with new fire doors, a designed and commissioned fire alarm with emergency lighting, and a new three-phase electrical supply.

  • Licensed six-bedroom HMO
  • FD30 fire doors, fire alarm and emergency lighting

Development questions

Can you help assess a development opportunity?

Yes. We can review site constraints, planning potential, access, likely construction route, specification, programme pressure and broad viability so clients can make better early decisions.

Do you work on joint venture development projects?

Yes. We can support suitable joint venture opportunities where the site, planning strategy, funding route and delivery structure are aligned from the outset.

Can you manage development from concept to completion?

Yes. We can coordinate acquisition input, planning support, consultants, design development, construction delivery, handover and long-term property enhancement through one joined-up team.

What type of development schemes do you focus on?

We focus on residential, commercial and mixed-use opportunities, including apartments, urban housing, student accommodation, HMOs, refurbishment-led value creation and new-build schemes.

Can you coordinate planning and building control?

We can coordinate with architects, engineers, planning consultants, building control and other appointed specialists so development, construction and inspection requirements are aligned.

Do you help before drawings are final?

Yes. Early input can help identify planning, buildability, sequencing, specification and cost pressures before work starts on site.

Who deals with structural details?

Structural design remains with the appointed engineer, while we coordinate the development route, construction sequence and practical site requirements around their information.

How early should we involve you?

The earlier the better. Development and pre-construction input can reduce surprises around planning, cost, sequencing, access and specification.

How long will my project take?

Programme depends on scope, approvals, lead times, structural complexity and site constraints. We set out realistic timing during proposal stage.

Can you fast-track urgent works?

Where the scope and supply chain allow it, we can prioritise enabling works, phased procurement and focused delivery milestones.
